{'text': 'Randy Rainbow 剛剛為粉絲送上強心針，以一場精彩絕倫的吐槽狠狠揶揄衞生部長小羅伯特·F·甘迺迪。', 'paragraph_context': 'Randy Rainbow just gave his fans a shot in the arm with a sick takedown of Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'}

{'text': "這位六度獲艾美獎提名的藝人，改編了《紅男綠女》中《Adelaide's Lament》一曲，藉此針砭這位對疫苗持懷疑態度的人物。", 'paragraph_context': 'The six-time Emmy nominee needled the vaccine skeptic in a tweaked knockoff of “Adelaide’s Lament” from “Guys and Dolls.”'}

{'text': 'Rainbow 形容總統當選人特朗普的內閣人選，是自《羅斯瑪麗的嬰兒》片中那位婦科醫生以來最不可信的醫療專業人士。', 'paragraph_context': 'Rainbow described President Donald Trump’s Cabinet choice as the least trustworthy medical professional since the gynecologist in “Rosemary’s Baby.”'}

{'text': '「換句話說，當一個根本不勝任的混蛋獲聘出掌要職／一個國家便可能染上風寒，」Rainbow 如此唱道。「你可能會因為他的 Tylenol 理論和禁用氟化物而欲哭無淚／而他所謂的證據更顯示接觸殺蟲劑或會令人變性／當各機構拚命想救我們於他那只懂顫抖的手中，一個國家便可能染上風寒。」', 'paragraph_context': '“In other words, when a jerk gets a job he’s profoundly unfit to hold/ a country can develop a cold,” Rainbow sang. “You could wind up in tears from his Tylenol theories and fluoride bans/ While his evidence shows pesticidal exposure might turn you trans/ With the agencies trying to save us from dying in shaky hands, a country can develop a cold. “'}

{'text': '歌曲進入尾聲部分時，他的心情依舊沒有好轉。', 'paragraph_context': 'His mood didn’t improve later in the song.'}

{'text': '「現在我抗抑鬱藥見底了，更怕消化我吃下的東西／多麼希望 Cheryl Hines 會逼他辭職，讓我心情好過一些／但他腦裏的蟲顯然已令他徹底瘋掉，而我們全部遭殃／這個國家已徹底完蛋。」', 'paragraph_context': '“Now I’m low on antidepressants and scared to digest my food/ How I wish Cheryl Hines would make him resign and improve my mood/ But the worms in his brain clearly drove him insane and now we’re all screwed/ The country can develop la shittes.”'}
